policy: Only provision IDs in this registry may appear in Act citation blocks. Each record was checked against an official primary legal text on the verification date. The subject field is a conservative paraphrase, not a quotation and not an applicability determination.

provisions.title: Human dignity
provisions.subject: Human dignity must be respected and protected.

provisions.title: Respect for private and family life
provisions.subject: Protects private and family life, home and communications.

provisions.title: Protection of personal data
provisions.subject: Recognises the right to protection of personal data.

provisions.title: Protection of personal data
provisions.subject: Requires fair processing for specified purposes and a lawful basis; recognises access and rectification.

provisions.title: Protection of personal data
provisions.subject: Requires independent control of compliance with personal-data rules.

provisions.title: Non-discrimination
provisions.subject: Prohibits discrimination on listed and comparable grounds.

provisions.title: Right to an effective remedy and to a fair trial
provisions.subject: Recognises an effective remedy and fair hearing for violations of EU-law rights.

provisions.title: Risk management system
provisions.subject: Requires a risk-management system for high-risk AI systems.

provisions.title: Risk management system
provisions.subject: Defines risk management as a continuous iterative lifecycle process with systematic review and updating.

provisions.title: Data and data governance
provisions.subject: Requires qualifying training, validation and testing datasets to meet Article 10 quality criteria for high-risk AI systems.

provisions.title: Data and data governance
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate data-governance and management practices for intended purpose, including origin and preparation of data.

provisions.title: Record-keeping
provisions.subject: Requires high-risk AI systems to technically allow automatic event logging over the system lifetime.

provisions.title: Record-keeping
provisions.subject: Requires logging capabilities sufficient for purpose-appropriate traceability and specified monitoring/risk functions.

provisions.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
provisions.subject: Requires sufficient transparency for deployers to interpret output and use the system appropriately.

provisions.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
provisions.subject: Requires concise, complete, correct, clear, relevant, accessible and comprehensible instructions for use.

provisions.title: Human oversight
provisions.subject: Requires high-risk AI systems to be designed for effective oversight by natural persons.

provisions.title: Human oversight
provisions.subject: Human oversight aims to prevent or minimise health, safety and fundamental-rights risks.

provisions.title: Human oversight
provisions.subject: Requires oversight measures commensurate with risks, autonomy and context of use.

provisions.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout the lifecycle of high-risk AI systems.

provisions.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
provisions.subject: Requires resilience to errors, faults and inconsistencies and addresses feedback-loop risks.

provisions.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
provisions.subject: Requires resilience against unauthorised attempts exploiting vulnerabilities and addresses AI-specific attacks including poisoning and adversarial examples.

provisions.title: Automatically generated logs
provisions.subject: Requires providers to keep Article 12 logs under their control for an appropriate period, subject to applicable law.

provisions.title: Corrective actions and duty of information
provisions.subject: Requires corrective action, withdrawal, disabling or recall where a provider considers a high-risk AI system non-conforming.

provisions.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
provisions.subject: Requires deployers to take appropriate technical and organisational measures to use systems according to instructions.

provisions.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
provisions.subject: Requires human oversight to be assigned to natural persons with necessary competence, training, authority and support.

provisions.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
provisions.subject: Requires input data under deployer control to be relevant and sufficiently representative for intended purpose.

provisions.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
provisions.subject: Requires monitoring of operation and suspension/use-related reporting when specified risks or serious incidents arise.

provisions.title: Transparency obligations
provisions.subject: Requires certain direct-interaction AI systems to inform natural persons they are interacting with AI, subject to exceptions.

provisions.title: Transparency obligations
provisions.subject: Requires certain AI-generated synthetic outputs to be machine-readably marked and detectable, subject to exceptions.

provisions.title: Lawfulness, fairness and transparency
provisions.subject: Requires personal data to be processed lawfully, fairly and transparently.

provisions.title: Purpose limitation
provisions.subject: Requires specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and restricts incompatible further processing.

provisions.title: Data minimisation
provisions.subject: Requires personal data to be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary.

provisions.title: Accuracy
provisions.subject: Requires personal data accuracy and appropriate rectification/erasure of inaccurate data.

provisions.title: Storage limitation
provisions.subject: Limits identifiable retention to what is necessary, subject to specified exceptions.

provisions.title: Integrity and confidentiality
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate security against unauthorised/unlawful processing and accidental loss, destruction or damage.

provisions.title: Automated individual decision-making
provisions.subject: Recognises a right not to be subject to certain solely automated decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects.

provisions.title: Safeguards for automated decisions
provisions.subject: Requires specified safeguards in certain permitted automated decisions, including the right to human intervention, expression of viewpoint and contestation.

provisions.title: Responsibility of the controller
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate measures to ensure and demonstrate compliance, reviewed and updated where necessary.

provisions.title: Data protection by design
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate technical and organisational measures integrating data-protection principles and safeguards.

provisions.title: Data protection by default
provisions.subject: Requires by default only personal data necessary for each specific purpose to be processed, including limits on amount, extent, storage and accessibility.

provisions.title: Security of processing
provisions.subject: Requires risk-appropriate technical and organisational security measures.

provisions.title: Security of processing — resilience
provisions.subject: Requires ability to ensure ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services.

provisions.title: Security of processing — restoration
provisions.subject: Requires ability to restore availability and access to personal data in a timely manner after an incident.

provisions.title: Security of processing — testing
provisions.subject: Requires a process for regularly testing, assessing and evaluating effectiveness of security measures.

provisions.title: Security risk assessment
provisions.subject: Requires consideration of processing risks including destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure or access.

provisions.title: Processing under authority
provisions.subject: Requires persons under controller/processor authority with data access not to process except on instructions unless required by law.

provisions.title: Personal data breach notification
provisions.subject: Requires controller notification of certain personal data breaches to the supervisory authority within the specified timeframe.

provisions.title: Governance
provisions.subject: Requires management bodies of in-scope entities to approve cybersecurity risk measures, oversee implementation and be subject to liability rules.

provisions.title: Governance training
provisions.subject: Requires management-body cybersecurity training and encourages employee training.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to manage cybersecurity risk and minimise incident impact.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing risk analysis and information-system security policies.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing incident handling.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing business continuity, backup/disaster recovery and crisis management.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing supply-chain security.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing security in acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling/disclosure.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing policies and procedures to assess effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing human-resources security, access-control policies and asset management.

provisions.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
provisions.subject: Requires measures addressing multi-factor or continuous authentication and secured communications, where appropriate.

provisions.title: Supply-chain risk
provisions.subject: Requires consideration of supplier/service-provider vulnerabilities and cybersecurity practices, including secure development.

provisions.title: Corrective measures
provisions.subject: Requires necessary, appropriate and proportionate corrective measures without undue delay when non-compliance with paragraph 2 measures is found.

provisions.title: Early warning
provisions.subject: Requires specified early warning for significant incidents without undue delay and within 24 hours.

provisions.title: Incident notification
provisions.subject: Requires specified incident notification without undue delay and within 72 hours.

provisions.title: Intermediate report
provisions.subject: Requires an intermediate status report on request.

provisions.title: Final report
provisions.subject: Requires a final report with specified incident information within one month of incident notification.

provisions.title: Ongoing-incident progress/final report
provisions.subject: Requires a progress report and later final report when an incident remains ongoing.

provisions.title: Krav i andra författningar
provisions.subject: Provides that other statutory security/incident requirements apply when their effect at least corresponds to specified Chapter 2 duties.

provisions.title: DORA carve-out
provisions.subject: Provides that Chapter 2 §§ 3–10 do not apply to operators covered by DORA, subject to the stated statutory rule.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to protect network/information systems and physical environment against incidents.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing risk-analysis and network/information-system security strategies.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing incident handling.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing continuity and crisis management.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing supply-chain security.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing security in acquisition, development and maintenance.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing strategies and procedures to assess effectiveness of security measures.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing basic cyber hygiene and cybersecurity training.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing cryptography and, when needed, encryption.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing personnel security, access control and asset management.

provisions.title: Säkerhetsåtgärder
provisions.subject: Requires security measures addressing authentication, secured communications and emergency communications when needed.

provisions.title: Utbildning
provisions.subject: Requires management persons of in-scope operators to undergo security-measures training.

provisions.title: Rapportering av betydande incidenter — initial information
provisions.subject: Requires notice of a significant incident without undue delay and at latest within 24 hours, with statutory significance criteria.

provisions.title: Incident notification
provisions.subject: Requires an incident notification within statutory time limits after awareness.

provisions.title: Intermediate report
provisions.subject: Requires a status-update report on authority request.

provisions.title: Final/progress report
provisions.subject: Requires a final report within the statutory timeframe or a progress report if incident is ongoing.

provisions.title: Regular security audits
provisions.subject: Authorises regular security audits of essential operators by supervisory authority or independent body.

provisions.title: Targeted security audits
provisions.subject: Authorises targeted security audits where special reasons exist.

provisions.title: Security scans
provisions.subject: Authorises security scans in cooperation with the operator.
